highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.3 preview fixes Linux ARM64 initialization and Ahead-of-Time runtime crashes.
highlights_body: It also refreshes bundled native dependencies and advances native binary mitigation coverage.

bullets.detail: Adds the fontconfig runtime dependency to the cross-compile sysroot to prevent Linux ARM64 startup crashes.
Applications compiled with IlcDisableReflection no longer fail during SkiaSharp initialization.
Updates libpng, libwebp, Brotli, and expat used by the packaged native assets.

contributor_summaries.sshumakov: Native binary mitigation improvements for Windows and Linux

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: Preview 1 focused on Linux ARM64 and Ahead-of-Time runtime reliability, native dependency updates, and binary hardening.
